scenarios.name: command_line_logging_disabled
scenarios.description: Real capture: a payload run from Downloads opens a cmd.exe that uses reg add to set ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled to 0, turning off command-line logging for process-creation events.
scenarios.alert: Alert on pedro-computer: process reg.exe. Review this process and its related activity.

otrf_metadata.title: Disabling Process Command Line Logging via Registry Modification

scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the change is a registry write (T1112) made from cmd.exe (T1059.003), started by a payload the user ran (T1204.002) that connects to 192.168.56.40:8443 (T1071.001, T1571). OTRF's T1562.002 is T1685.001 in current ATT&CK; scoring maps both.
